items.title: 商汤日日新开源模型实现空间智能性能突破，多项评测领先 GPT-5
items.raw_excerpt: 今天，商汤日日新在空间智能领域实现重要突破，正式发布并开源SenseNova-SI系列模型。在多项权威评测的空间理解和推理任务上，SenseNova-SI 不仅大幅度领先同量级开源多模态大模型，还超越了 GPT-5 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro 等国际顶尖闭源模型的表现。 空间智能短板与系统性解决 当下行业领先的大模型，虽然在知识、写作、推理、编程等方面展示了突出的性能，但是普遍存在一个重要的缺陷，就是对空间结构的理解和推理存在很严重的短板，而这恰恰是具身智能体与世界交互所需要的关键基础能力。 我们来看一个例子，左图源自最强大脑的图形推理题，对人类都具有相当的难度，GPT-5能够轻松破解，可见它在非空间智能问题上已具备很强能力。反观右图，是一道人类儿童都能轻易解决的简单空间问题，要求选择正确俯视图，GPT-5却令人意外地犯起了难，错误地选择了"A”。   以上例子恰好暴露了当前大模型在空间理解上的短板。因此要让AI真正"看懂"三维世界，空间智能一直是关键的试金石。 商汤围绕空间智能进行了深入创新探索，找到了提升空间智能的系统性训练方法，打造了日日新·空间智能大模型系列 SenseNova-SI 并正式开源。 评测表现多项任务超越GPT-5，显著领先同量级开源模型 这次开源的SenseNova-SI空间智能大模型系列包括 2B 和 8B 两个规格。 最新评测数据显示，SenseNova-SI系列模型在空间智能多个基准测试（VSI、MMSI、MindCube、ViewSpatial）中表现突出，具体如下：   数据来源：https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-SI 其中SenseNova-SI-8B模型在四个基

excerpt_i18n.en:
Today, SenseTime's Rixin achieved a significant breakthrough in spatial intelligence by officially releasing and open-sourcing the SenseNova-SI series models. In multiple authoritative evaluations of spatial understanding and reasoning tasks, SenseNova-SI not only substantially outperformed open-source multimodal large models of similar scale but also surpassed the performance of top international closed-source models like GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro.

Currently, leading large models in the industry demonstrate outstanding capabilities in knowledge, writing, reasoning, and programming, yet they commonly suffer from a major weakness: a severe deficiency in understanding and reasoning about spatial structures, which is a critical foundational ability for embodied agents to interact with the world.

Consider an example: the left image, derived from a graphical reasoning puzzle on The Brain, poses considerable difficulty even for humans, yet GPT-5 solves it effortlessly, highlighting its strong capabilities in non-spatial intelligence. In contrast, the right image presents a simple spatial problem that even human children can easily solve, requiring the selection of the correct top-down view, but GPT-5 surprisingly struggles and incorrectly chooses option A.

This example precisely exposes the current shortcomings of large models in spatial understanding. Therefore, for AI to truly comprehend the three-dimensional world, spatial intelligence remains a key benchmark.

SenseTime focuses on...
excerpt_i18n.es: Hoy, SenseTime's RiRiXin logró un avance clave en inteligencia espacial, lanzando y liberando oficialmente la serie de modelos SenseNova-SI. En múltiples evaluaciones autorizadas de tareas de comprensión y razonamiento espacial, SenseNova-SI no solo superó significativamente a grandes modelos multimodales de código abierto de escala similar, sino que también superó el rendimiento de modelos cerrados líderes internacionales como GPT-5 y Gemini 2.5 Pro. Deficiencias y soluciones sistémicas en inteligencia espacial: aunque los grandes modelos líderes actuales muestran fortalezas destacadas en conocimiento, escritura, razonamiento y programación.

items.raw_excerpt: 2025 年 11 月 9 日，即梦 AI 联合抖音、抖音精选正式发布 “即梦 AI 青年导演合作计划”，并在上海大光明电影院举办首期七部 AI 短片的首映礼。该计划致力于 “拆掉创作路上的围墙”，为富有创想的创作者配备 “想象力引擎”，推动 “新导演、用新技术、讲新故事” 的行业愿景落地。 9日即梦AI青年导演合作计划首期作品在上海首映   三重资源，助力青年导演降低创作门槛 11 月 9 日， “即梦 AI 青年导演合作计划”在上海正式发布。首期集结了蓝天、曾赠、胤超、祝新、陈小雨、小文、“影视飓风” 团队等七组 85 后至 95 后的青年导演，由即梦AI提供技术支持，进行非命题式创作。   七位导演现场分享AI创作感受  历时近100天，几位青年导演成功将脑海中的故事转化为具备“影视级质感”的 AI 影像。蓝天的《畲战：狗王传说》以畲族神话为基底，融合中式美学；曾赠的《大梦》以“庄周梦蝶”为内核，构建多重时空交叠的叙事结构；胤超的《河水东流又往西》借助“烛龙”意象，探讨个体在时代洪流中的命运；祝新的《东方既白》以马可·波罗与忽必烈为原型，用AI重构历史与传说；影视飓风团队的《海豚的故事》以科幻设定反思人性选择；小文执导的《老妈的心愿》以真实家庭故事为蓝本，呈现代际情感与AI技术的温情结合；陈小雨的《珍贵的脏》则以童话外衣包裹现实哲思，探讨“独特源于经历”的生命主题。 胤超的《河水东流又向西》用写实风格表现时间流逝 祝新介绍，影视化马克·波罗故事的想法自己

excerpt_i18n.en: On November 9, 2025, JIMENG AI, in collaboration with Douyin and Douyin Selection, officially launched the JIMENG AI Young Directors Collaboration Program and held the premiere of its first seven AI short films at the Grand Cinema in Shanghai. The program aims to dismantle barriers in the creative process, equip imaginative creators with an imagination engine, and advance the industry vision of new directors using new technologies to tell new stories. On November 9, the first works of the JIMENG AI Young Directors Collaboration Program premiered in Shanghai. Three key resources help young directors lower the barriers to creation. On November 9, the JIMENG AI Young Directors Collaboration Program was officially launched in Shanghai. The first phase brought together seven groups of young directors born between the 1980s and 1990s, including Lan Tian, Zeng Zeng, Yin Chao, Zhu Xin, Chen Xiaoyu, Xiao Wen, and the "Film Tornado" team. With technical support from JIMENG AI, they engaged in non-prescriptive creation. Seven directors shared their experiences with AI creation on-site. Over nearly 100 days, these young directors successfully transformed their story ideas into film-quality productions.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 9 de noviembre de 2025, Jimeng AI, en colaboración con Douyin y Douyin Select, lanzó oficialmente el "Plan de Colaboración para Jóvenes Directores de Jimeng AI", celebrando el estreno de las primeras siete películas cortas de IA en el Cine Grand Theatre de Shanghái. Esta iniciativa busca "derribar los muros en el camino creativo", equipando a creadores innovadores con un "motor de imaginación" para impulsar "nuevos directores, usando nuevas tecnologías, contando nuevas historias".

items.title: 美团首款AI IDE产品CatPaw进入公测 支持龙猫等多种模型混合调用
items.raw_excerpt: 11月10日，美团旗下首款AI IDE产品Meituan CatPaw（简称“CatPaw”）进入公测。该产品是以Agent与人协作为核心，通过Agent智能驱动编程，支持代码补全、项目预览调试等功能。用户在官网下载安装后，在官方公众号领取邀请码体验，初始账号默认能发起500次对话，使用完可申请获取新额度。   ▲美团公测首款AI IDE产品Meituan CatPaw（资料图） 据美团CatPaw产品负责人介绍，CatPaw早在2023年就在美团内部以编辑器插件形态上线，此次完成全面升级后进行公开测试。该产品目前在美团内部研发渗透率超 95%，增量代码 AI 生成率超 50%。此外，CatPaw搭载了美团自研的基于编程场景特训的LongCat模型，并支持多种模型混合调用，以更好地完成不同任务。 具体来看，当前阶段的CatPaw版本，核心定位是帮助程序员等专业人士更好地完成编码工作。 产品支持 Ask、Agent 等多种对话模式。当用户希望快速了解项目逻辑或如何开始一个项目时，可使用Ask模式快速提问，或使用Agent模式基于整个项目进行完整分析。 在编码过程中，CatPaw能基于编写的代码实时进行编码提示，具备当前光标位置补全提示、下一步编码位置预测、批量修改预测等功能，开发者只需要操作Tab键就能快速采纳代码，在手动编码中实现“解放双手”。 此外，输入任务要求后，CatPaw支持通过配置Rules、System Prompt、Docs的方式为Agent输入更多任务规范、知识库，同时通过MCP接入方式扩展更多工具能力，从而更好地执行编码任务。 最后，当开发前端项目编码完成后，用户可在CatPaw内直接预览前端页面，在预览时对不满意的结果也可直接选中区域局部优化，并能在预览模式下实时查看console调试信息进行问题调试。

excerpt_i18n.en:
On November 10, Meituan's first AI IDE product, Meituan CatPaw, entered public beta. Centered on Agent-human collaboration, it enables intelligent Agent-driven programming and supports features like code completion and project preview debugging. After downloading and installing from the official website, users can obtain an invitation code via the official public account to try it out. Initial accounts allow 500 dialogue interactions by default, with new quotas available upon depletion.

According to Meituan's CatPaw product lead, CatPaw was initially launched internally at Meituan in 2023 as an editor plugin and has now undergone a comprehensive upgrade for public testing. Currently, it has over 95% penetration in Meituan's internal R&D and generates over 50% of incremental code via AI. Additionally, CatPaw incorporates Meituan's self-developed LongCat model, trained specifically for programming scenarios, and supports mixed model calls to better handle diverse tasks.

In its current phase, CatPaw is primarily designed to assist professionals like programmers in coding tasks. It offers multiple dialogue modes, including Ask and Agent. Users can employ Ask mode for quick queries about project logic or getting started, or use Agent mode for comprehensive analysis based on the entire project. During coding, CatPaw...
excerpt_i18n.es: El 10 de noviembre, CatPaw, el primer producto IDE con IA de Meituan, entró en fase de prueba pública. Este producto se centra en la colaboración entre agentes y humanos, impulsando la programación mediante inteligencia de agentes, con funciones como autocompletado de código y previsualización y depuración de proyectos. Tras descargarlo e instalarlo desde su sitio web, los usuarios pueden obtener un código de invitación en la cuenta oficial de WeChat para probarlo. items.title: Free ChatGPT for transitioning U.S. servicemembers and veterans
items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI is offering U.S. servicemembers and veterans within 12 months of retirement or separation a free year of ChatGPT Plus to support their transition to civilian life. The tools can help with resumes, interviews, education, and planning for what’s next.

title_i18n.en: Free ChatGPT for transitioning U.S. servicemembers and veterans
title_i18n.zh: 美国现役军人及退伍军人的免费ChatGPT服务
title_i18n.es: ChatGPT gratuito para miembros del servicio estadounidense en transición y veteranos

excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI is offering U.S. servicemembers and veterans within 12 months of retirement or separation a free year of ChatGPT Plus to support their transition to civilian life. The tools can help with resumes, interviews, education, and planning for what’s next.
excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI为美国现役军人及退伍12个月内的退役军人提供一年免费的ChatGPT Plus服务，以协助他们顺利过渡到平民生活。该工具可辅助制作简历、准备面试及规划教育发展。
excerpt_i18n.es: OpenAI ofrece a los miembros del servicio y veteranos estadounidenses que se encuentren dentro de los 12 meses previos a la jubilación o baja un año gratuito de ChatGPT Plus para apoyar su transición a la vida civil. Las herramientas pueden ayudar con currículums, entrevistas y educación.
